tasks.title: Write our own conv + CTC decoder. Copy no Meta code
tasks.notes: fidetype.decoders.conv_ctc: our own code. Spatial 306→256, per-subject affine, 5 dilated residual blocks (width 320), stride-4 downsample to 25 Hz, aux CTC head + self-conditioning, 4-layer custom Conformer (d=256). 10.06 M params (1 subject), 10.32 M (5). Loss 0.3·final + 0.7·aux. Causal mode via lookahead_frames (tested). 169 tests pass in the GPU env. The single agent run covers M1-01, M1-02, M1-03 and M1-05. It includes about 2 h of waiting caused by CPU contention with preprocessing.
